title: RSF Recaptures Kurmuk, Blue Nile, as SAF Withdraws
detail: The RSF announced on August 13, 2026 that it had recaptured Kurmuk, Blue Nile State — the second Blue Nile town it has seized in a week, after Geisan on August 11 — as Sudanese army forces withdrew. RSF fighters said they chased SAF combatants out of the town and seized large amounts of hardware and ammunition, and video showed RSF personnel celebrating the takeover. The RSF had originally seized Kurmuk on March 23, 2026, staging from Ethiopia, before the army recaptured it on July 8; the mass grave of 25 civilians was discovered there just four days earlier, on August 9. Kurmuk sits roughly 140km from the Blue Nile state capital Ed Damazin and 160km from the strategically vital Roseires Dam. SAF had not publicly responded to the loss of either town at time of writing.

title: Army, Joint Forces Repel 250-Vehicle RSF Assault on Jabrat al-Shaikh, North Kordofan
detail: The Sudanese army and allied Joint Forces repelled the RSF's largest assault in weeks on Jabrat al-Shaikh, North Kordofan, on August 13, 2026, following nearly two days of unprecedented RSF troop buildups staging from neighboring Darfur. The offensive targeted the town's defenses from three directions with an estimated 250 combat vehicles, including armored units. After heavy fighting, the army and its allies destroyed numerous RSF vehicles, captured roughly 60 more, and killed dozens of RSF fighters; Joint Forces media released footage of destroyed and captured vehicles and captured combatants. Control of Jabrat al-Shaikh is critical to the transport corridor the RSF has sought to sever to pressure El Obeid and Omdurman.

title: RSF Drones Hit Omdurman, El Obeid, Kadugli, and River Nile State for Second Day
detail: RSF drones attacked Omdurman and other army-held cities for a second consecutive day on August 13, 2026, following the previous day's coordinated strikes on five cities. SAF air defenses shot down 10 drones over Omdurman, 3 over River Nile State, and 5 over South Kordofan State (Kadugli); an army source told AFP that 'military air defences engaged with the militia's drones and downed them.' No immediate casualties or material damage were reported in Omdurman. The renewed strikes also targeted El Obeid (North Kordofan) as fighting intensified on multiple fronts in Kordofan and Blue Nile.
